# Artifact 3 & 6: Comprehensive Requirements & Traceability Matrix

**Generated By:** Agent_02_Requirements
**Domain Focus:** Object-Oriented Specification Maps

## 1. Elicited Requirements (Epics & Fully Dressed User Stories)

### Epic 1: Tournament Operations & The Draw Engine
*   **US-1.1 (Blueprint):** As a Delegate, I want to define a tournament blueprint (metadata, categories) so I can initialize the state machine before accepting players.
*   **US-1.2 (Auto-Draws):** As a Delegate, I want the system to automatically generate a Knockout bracket (auto-calculating the nearest power of 2 and assigning Byes) based on the registered player count, so I don't have to do math manually.
*   **US-1.3 (Pools Draft):** As a Delegate, I want the option to generate Round Robin pools using a "snake draft" algorithm to ensure top seeds are evenly distributed across groups.
*   **US-1.4 (Manual Override):** As a Delegate, I want to manually override algorithmic seeds and swap player positions in a "Draft" state before clicking "Publish Draw".

### Epic 2: Live Match Execution & Field Operations
*   **US-2.1 (Offline Umpiring):** As an Umpire, I want my scoring tablet to cache data locally if the Wi-Fi drops, and automatically push the backlog of points to the server when I reconnect, ensuring no data is lost.
*   **US-2.2 (Undo Stack):** As an Umpire, I want the ability to "Undo" a point, which must immediately reflect on the broadcaster screens and be logged in the audit trail as a correction.
*   **US-2.3 (Court Queueing):** As a Marshall, I want a visual dashboard showing the status of all physical courts (e.g., "Empty", "Warmup", "Set 3") so I can efficiently assign the next queued match.

### Epic 3: Data Broadcast & IT Infrastructure
*   **US-3.1 (Dual-Layer Broadcast):** As a Broadcaster, I want a private control desk where I can queue up graphics (sponsors, lower thirds) and push them to a separate, clean presentation window for OBS/Vmix capture.
*   **US-3.2 (Automated Scorebugs):** As a Broadcaster, I want the on-screen scorebug to animate and update automatically the millisecond the Umpire presses a button, without me having to type the score.
*   **US-3.3 (Device Telemetry):** As a Network Admin, I want to see the battery life and ping latency of every Umpire tablet on the grounds so I can swap out dying iPads before a match is interrupted.

## 2. Strict Functional Requirements (FR)
*   **FR-01 (Bracket Math):** The Draw Engine MUST automatically calculate the required bracket size (8, 16, 32, 64, 128) based on `N` players, and MUST assign exactly `(BracketSize - N)` Byes. Byes MUST be placed against the highest-ranked seeds first.
*   **FR-02 (State Enforcement):** The Tournament Object MUST strictly follow the transition: `INIT -> PRE -> LIVE -> POST -> ARCHIVED`. Any attempt to transition backward (e.g., `LIVE -> PRE`) MUST be blocked at the API level.
*   **FR-03 (Archival Cryptography/Lock):** Once a tournament transitions to `ARCHIVED`, the system MUST reject all CRUD write requests to child match data. The database trigger MUST throw an `ILLEGAL MUTATION` error.
*   **FR-04 (Role-Based Routing):** A user with the `UMPIRE` role attempting to access the `/delegate` URL MUST be intercepted by Middleware and redirected, preventing cross-contamination of sandboxes.

## 3. Strict Non-Functional Requirements (NFR)
*   **NFR-01 (WebSocket Latency):** Score mutations pushed by the Umpire MUST propagate to all subscribed Read-Only clients (Broadcaster, Fans) in **< 200 milliseconds** under standard 4G/Wi-Fi conditions.
*   **NFR-02 (Offline Resilience):** Umpire devices MUST utilize `IndexedDB` or `LocalStorage` to retain state during network partitions. The app must function seamlessly offline for up to 5 hours.
*   **NFR-03 (Audit Immutability):** The Audit Ledger MUST be an append-only structure. `UPDATE` and `DELETE` SQL commands on the audit table MUST be disabled at the database user-permission level.
*   **NFR-04 (Payload Optimization):** The "Live" JSON payload sent to edge devices MUST NOT exceed **500 KB**. When "Archived", the payload MUST drop below **50 KB** via data flattening.

## 4. Acceptance Criteria (Given / When / Then)

**Scenario A: The Offline Umpire Edge Case**
*   *Given* an Umpire is scoring Match 12 and the Wi-Fi router loses power.
*   *When* the Umpire scores 3 consecutive points while offline.
*   *Then* the UI must indicate an "Offline / Caching" status.
*   *And* when the Wi-Fi returns, the system must immediately push the 3 points in a single bulk mutation array.
*   *And* the Broadcaster UI must instantly update to reflect the 3 new points.

**Scenario B: The Delegate Kill-Switch**
*   *Given* the tournament is in the `LIVE` state and a rainstorm floods the courts.
*   *When* the Delegate presses the "Global Suspension" Kill-Switch.
*   *Then* all Umpire tablets must instantly lock out input and display "RAIN DELAY".
*   *And* all Broadcaster outputs must automatically switch to a "Tournament Suspended" graphic.

## 5. MoSCoW Prioritization & Traceability Matrix

| Feature / Requirement | Traceability (Epic/FR/NFR) | Priority (MoSCoW) | Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Central State Machine & Archival Lock** | Epic 1, FR-02, FR-03 | **Must Have** | The entire system relies on a single source of truth. |
| **Algorithmic Draw Engine (Knockouts/Byes)** | Epic 1, FR-01 | **Must Have** | Manual draws cause fatal errors; automation is core MVP. |
| **Umpire Offline Cache & Sync** | Epic 2, NFR-02, Scenario A | **Must Have** | Wi-Fi at tennis courts is notoriously unreliable. Cannot lose points. |
| **Role-Based Workspaces & Middleware** | Epic 2, FR-04 | **Must Have** | Security and UX depend on isolated sandboxes. |
| **Broadcaster Dual-Layer Output** | Epic 3, NFR-01 | **Should Have** | Highly desired for premium feel, but tournament can run without TV. |
| **Pools / Round Robin Snake Drafts** | Epic 1, US-1.3 | **Should Have** | Required for junior tournaments, less critical for pro knockouts. |
| **IT Command Center / Remote Reboot** | Epic 3, US-3.2 | **Could Have** | Nice to have for large scale events, but lower priority for MVP. |
| **Player Registration App / Portal** | Out of Scope | **Won't Have (Phase 1)** | We are mocking registrations for now to focus on operations. |
